name: BagUI
summary: Open-source shadcn/ui registry with 38+ React blocks and templates for building SaaS landing pages.
description: A blocks library for marketing and app pages: 38 blocks across marketing, app and ecommerce categories, built with React, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. Register the Bag/UI namespace once and install any block with a single shadcn CLI command; interactive blocks may include Framer Motion or GSAP animations. Free and MIT licensed, with optional sponsorship.
contains: 38 registry items across marketing, app and ecommerce categories
marketing blocks: hero 6, feature 3, pricing 4, cta 2, navbar 2, footer 3, team 1, contact 2, sign-up 2
install through the Bag/UI shadcn namespace with one CLI command
Framer Motion or GSAP animations in interactive blocks
React + shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS with dark mode support
MIT licensed, free without an account; optional sponsorship
templates, changelog and docs alongside the blocks
